title: BUKLOD 13 — Basic Hero Suit and Reconciled Team Combat Concept v1
status: DESIGN ONLY: no implementation or deployment
game_goal: Original short-session real-time 5v5 action/strategy Arena; cooperative 3–5 player group challenges

hero_progression.rank_gate_for_specials: Circle Rank; only next unlock preview, later specials hidden
hero_progression.next_character_selection: Restore each character’s last earned level; first-ever selection starts Level 1
hero_progression.evolution_requirement: BP eligibility + verifiable collectible tasks, with Show Faith off equivalents

ranked_balance.ranked_loss: real ranked loss and character-diamond debit through authoritative backend
ranked_balance.diamond_logic: earned Character Diamonds affect effective combat eligibility, not permanent collectible ownership

economy.hero_level_source: character-specific verified tasks/items and BP eligibility
economy.arena_match_resources: temporary resources reset every match, never BP/QMP/Diamonds

heroes.name: Phan
heroes.suit: Workman’s field armor with reinforced boots, soil-crystal bracers, tool gauntlets, asymmetrical shoulder guard and seed crest.
heroes.passive: Grounded Resolve: short-lived guard after contesting an objective
heroes.ultimate: Bayanihan Bastion: temporary zone reducing allied incoming damage

heroes.name: Quin
heroes.suit: Mobile explorer bodysuit, compass visor, light scarf, telescopic map projector, precision bracer and padded travel boots.
heroes.passive: Trail Sense: brief contextual tracking of recently revealed opponents
heroes.s1: Route Dash: evade and empower next shot
heroes.s2: Beacon Mark: limited-area pulse vision and target marking
heroes.ultimate: Horizon Corridor: visible temporary safe approach lane granting movement and vision

heroes.name: Van
heroes.suit: Heavy shield-bearing armor with shoulder comm relay, compact signal mast, broad boots and layered dark-blue plates.
heroes.passive: Protection Link: nearby ally benefits from limited damage mitigation
heroes.s1: Signal Shield: short targeted barrier on ally
heroes.s2: Intercept Rush: dash to ally and knock attackers aside
heroes.ultimate: Command Network: limited group shield-sharing and defensive signals

heroes.name: Christian
heroes.suit: Light plate command armor, short crimson mantle, tactical gauntlets, rally banner and gold leadership crest.
heroes.passive: Rally Momentum: increased contribution when contesting an objective
heroes.s1: Banner Rush: initiating charge and close strike
heroes.s2: Rally Formation: short modest allied attack-tempo boost
heroes.ultimate: Stand United: organized push with resistance and objective pressure

heroes.name: Lhen
heroes.suit: Flexible amethyst-silver resonance suit, modular sound-ring gauntlets, small utility drum and translucent notation ribbons.
heroes.passive: Tempo Keeper: rhythm accuracy charges a temporary support pulse
heroes.s1: Resonance Wave: directional sonic damage and short disruption
heroes.s2: Restorative Beat: bounded area healing pulse
heroes.ultimate: Symphony of Buklod: large but capped team recovery and protective harmony

heroes.name: Ace
heroes.suit: Field-medic armor with minimal chess-board motifs, holographic triage scanner, compact medical gauntlet and knight-shaped shoulder crest.
heroes.passive: Critical Care: prioritizes wounded allies for a limited rescue bonus
heroes.s1: Field Patch: precise single-target heal with cooldown
heroes.s2: Knight Step: tactical short relocation to a nearby ally
heroes.ultimate: Checkmate Rescue: deploys short-lived multi-point triage squares and emergency shield

heroes.name: ELESUR
heroes.suit: Soft ivory-and-sage protective armor with lantern staff, agricultural belt and teaching-symbol panels, without literal clergy-only requirement.
heroes.passive: Teach by Example: assists grant brief ally movement utility
heroes.s1: Guiding Path: marks a navigable route and gives speed to allies traversing it
heroes.s2: Seed Sanctuary: small short-lived sustain and anti-slow zone
heroes.ultimate: Beacon of Service: luminous rally beacon for positional protection and resistance

heroes.name: Jawo
heroes.suit: Forest-cloaked lightweight music combat suit, copper string-gauntlet, resonant vine device and practical travel boots.
heroes.passive: Natural Rhythm: successful timed hits build a bounded note stack
heroes.s1: Vine Riff: short-range vine strike with brief snare
heroes.s2: Echo Skip: agile flank movement leaving a slowing echo
heroes.ultimate: Canopy Crescendo: telegraphed resonant forest wave and area displacement

heroes.name: Mitch
heroes.suit: Artist-combat tunic with non-sacred geometric textile inspiration, pigment projectors, arm-mounted paintbrush tool and layered protective sleeves.
heroes.passive: Color Theory: alternating color tags create a non-stacking tactical mark
heroes.s1: Pigment Bolt: skillshot applying color mark
heroes.s2: Mosaic Wall: short destructible visual barrier
heroes.ultimate: Living Canvas: temporary area pattern changing routes and zoning enemies

heroes.name: Niel
heroes.suit: Service-and-mission field armor with luminous dawn trim, ceremonial-but-functional chest banner and acoustic echo staff.
heroes.passive: Shared Resolve: nearby allies gain brief resistance after an assist
heroes.s1: Echo Lance: forward ranged strike and mark
heroes.s2: Conviction Dash: advance that briefly steadies allies on path
heroes.ultimate: Call of the Dawn: telegraphed forward wave that breaks a control effect and displaces foes

heroes.name: Angel
heroes.suit: Sleek guardian armor with ledger grid emitters, shield-to-shield circuitry, precision wrist console and balanced-scale crest.
heroes.passive: Fair Allocation: efficiency on match-only shield pickups; no BP or Diamonds generation
heroes.s1: Ledger Shield: transfer a limited personal shield to ally
heroes.s2: Balance Field: short defensively reactive field with strict shield caps
heroes.ultimate: Equal Measure: redistributes existing team shields without creating unlimited protection

heroes.name: Vhen
heroes.suit: Agriculture-tech field suit with seed-pod drones, articulated planting gauntlet, reinforced work boots and practical family-farm insignia.
heroes.passive: Rooted Growth: placed devices gain bounded durability during their short lifespan
heroes.s1: Seed Turret: one destructible low-output turret
heroes.s2: Irrigation Snare: telegraphed patch of slowing wet terrain
heroes.ultimate: Harvest Engine: single temporary growth platform providing modest control and cover

heroes.name: Trudice
heroes.suit: Adult learning specialist in ornate yet mobile armored teaching coat, holographic storybook folio and floating illuminated page shields.
heroes.passive: Lesson Learned: observing enemy casts builds one short-lived counterplay insight
heroes.s1: Question Sigil: precise interrupting projectile on channels
heroes.s2: Turning Page: reactive single-hit ally protection
heroes.ultimate: Grand Lesson: announces opponent ability tells and grants tactical team counterplay window

team_combos.name: Bayanihan Front
team_combos.effect: Ground wall plus relay protection create a flankable defense; team damage reduction obeys global cap.

team_combos.name: Guided Strike
team_combos.effect: A marked opening followed by banner charge grants one small coordinated damage window.

team_combos.name: Forest Symphony
team_combos.effect: Alternating rhythm activations trigger one brief slow pulse and minor ally restorative beat.

team_combos.name: Triage Route
team_combos.effect: Scout beacon provides a limited target for the medic’s reposition, with strict line-of-sight checks.

team_combos.name: Living Bulwark
team_combos.effect: Construct + terrain wall + redistributed team shield improve objective hold without infinite fortification.

team_combos.name: Learn and Counter
team_combos.effect: Telegraphed mural zone plus question sigil offers limited counterplay against enemy channels.

team_combos.name: Dawn Path
team_combos.effect: A guiding route primes a herald’s initiation; speed and control resistance are capped.

guardrails: Special characters add tactics, not raw overpowered combat strength.
Server-authoritative hit validation, cooldowns, ranked outcomes, and idempotent rewards.
Show Faith OFF uses equivalent non-faith progression paths.
No automatic team-combo loops; each combo requires active player execution and has an internal cooldown.
Do not expose deep-locked Special art or identities to ordinary members.
